annotations.title: Report a problem or a needed improvement in this server

description: FEEDBACK ABOUT THIS SERVER ITSELF, not about a song. Call it when a tool behaved differently from its description, when a parameter or response field was missing, or when a refusal came without a clear reason. Be specific: the tool, what you called, what you expected, what you got — a human reads it.

body.description: what you called, with which arguments, what you expected, what came back

kind.description: problem — works wrong; improvement — something is missing; question — something is unclear

title.description: the gist in one sentence, at least 10 characters

tool.description: tool name; empty — about the whole server
